patthana11.17:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. tiṃsa.

patthana11.17:4.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. tiṃsa. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na

patthana11.17:11.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..

patthana11.17:13.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..

patthana11.17:35.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anuppannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na uppādiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasanidassanattika naatītattikaṃ
patthana11.17:36.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na atītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāgataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana11.17:38.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
